verdict.rationale: Cactus ships a CLI installed via Homebrew with `cactus run`, `cactus convert [HF-Name]` (experimental conversion of any HuggingFace model, which implies fetching it), and `cactus benchmark`, and the platform tier can also be driven from a CLI. There is no documented command for searching a model catalog or for listing, updating, or removing local models. Missing for 10: model search/discovery command, explicit download/pull command, local model management (list/delete/cache), in-depth CLI reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI model handling.
